en_US.title: Pressure Failure Thresholds
en_US.scanner: A good sample can become a hazard by crossing the wrong pressure line.
en_US.field_note: Failure thresholds should be readable before they punish.
en_US.terminal: THRESHOLDS: shallow-rated, industrial-rated, brine-rated, abyssal-rated and Atlas-rated containers are distinct. A mismatch causes drift, fracture, bloom or dead-sample contamination.
en_US.audio: Pressure does not care that the label was almost right.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Pressure failure thresholds make salvage decisions physical and visible instead of abstract inventory math.
en_US.external_site: Pressure failure thresholds define when containment, crafting, and salvage cross from useful sample into fracture, bloom, drift, or contamination.

ru_RU.title: Пороги отказа под давлением
ru_RU.scanner: Хороший образец может стать угрозой, перейдя неправильную линию давления.
ru_RU.field_note: Пороги отказа должны читаться до наказания.
ru_RU.terminal: THRESHOLDS: shallow-rated, industrial-rated, brine-rated, abyssal-rated и Atlas-rated containers различаются. Несовпадение вызывает drift, fracture, bloom или dead-sample contamination.
ru_RU.audio: Давлению все равно, что ярлык был почти верным.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Пороги отказа делают salvage decisions физическими и видимыми, а не абстрактной inventory math.
ru_RU.external_site: RU LOC HOLD: Pressure failure thresholds define when containment, crafting, and salvage cross from useful sample into fracture, bloom, drift, or contamination.

en_US.title: Blue Debt Sample Quality
en_US.scanner: Blue debt quality is value, risk and evidence in one number.
en_US.field_note: Quality should affect payout, containment and ending pressure.
en_US.terminal: QUALITY CLASSES: shard, casketed bloom, harmonic glass, live-contaminated sample and dead contaminated glass. Higher value increases Deep Reach pressure and handling cost.
en_US.audio: The more it is worth, the less it is only loot.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Blue debt sample quality lets endings, scanner warnings, and material records treat resources as moral pressure rather than generic loot.
en_US.external_site: Blue Debt Sample Quality defines payout and evidence classes.

en_US.title: Vent Forge Process Steps
en_US.scanner: Vent forging should feel like using the planet against itself.
en_US.field_note: Make forge steps readable as heat, pressure, wait and risk.
en_US.terminal: FORGE STEPS: purge brine, clamp blank, preheat on vent pulse, seal during pressure lull, quench in cold current, certify by acoustic ring. Wrong timing makes useful scrap.
en_US.audio: The moon is the furnace. The player is only allowed to borrow it.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Vent forge steps turn hard-sci-fi resource lore into future crafting beats without simulating chemistry.
en_US.external_site: Vent Forge Process Steps describe the industrial fantasy behind HECTON-8 crafting: heat, pressure, custody, and debt turned into usable parts.
